description: dataset.gov.md: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataset.gov.md. Coverage: the area served by dataset.gov.md. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Date cu privire la reparația drumurilor din Fondul Rutier pentru 2016; Strazi; Repartizarea mijloacelor Fondului rutier pentru drumurile publice nați; Lista drumurilor publice naționale din Republica Moldova. Formats seen: PDF, XLS, XLSX, DOCX, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is License Not Specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
